preconditions.description: The number of rows in the matrix is between 1 and 10^3, inclusive.
The number of columns in the matrix is between 1 and 10^3, inclusive.
Each cell in the matrix is either a landmine (0) or safe (1).

postconditions.description: The output is either the length of the shortest safe path or -1 if no such path exists.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 if no safe path exists
postconditions.description: The output is -1 if there is no path from any cell in the first column to any cell in the last column that avoids landmines and their adjacent cells.
The output is a positive integer representing the length of the shortest safe path from the first column to the last column.
